dialogue_texts: I don't know what the heck happened and how my mind got taken over again...
It seems my eternal light has successfully burned away that tacky magical trance you were trapped in.
I want to hurry and escape this place, but...
If you truly wish to find peace...
You must first explain exactly what sort of uninvited vermin have been using your estate for their little games.
With your intervention, you should help most of Gensokyo's population return to their uncursed forms.
Still, if resolving this little incident clears the path to returning my lovely nights to normal...
I suppose a real princess can lend a hand.
I really want to help you, but I somehow can't!
If the burden is simply too grand for a fragile fledgling like you, do not push yourself.
Merely point the way to where this hidden director is hiding, and I shall take care of the rest.
My, what an aggressively unrefined voice.
To bark at a noble lady who has simply deigned to tidy up uninvited clutter in her backyard...
If you thought I could give up my princess to you, you're dumber than me!
All the time I spent powering up my greatest invention will pay off in a big way!
I will continue to take over Gensokyo's people for myself! They will be forced to trust the Order!
Oh, looks like I definitely have to leave now!
Feel free to multiply your numbers as much as you like.
The absolute eternity of the Moon does not yield to a crowd.
If these ruffians genuinely believe their cheap parlor tricks can dictate the flow of our night...
They are about to receive a very flashy lesson in reality.
If you thought Berenice Grieg was enough, turns out she has another subordinate and is responsible for this!
A mastermind hiding in the shadows?
A classic theatrical trope, yet dreadfully lacking in true elegance.
Tell me where this leader resides; a prompt eviction is in order.
That's right. Berenice has... a twin sister!
A mirrored pair makes for a lovely boundary of identity...
Though it simply means I have twice the weeds to clear from my sight.
When Berenice broke into this place, I attempted to fight her off with my own danmaku.
But then she cursed me with this glohm stuff!
It caused me to act antagonistically, and you managed to come in earlier and undo the curse.
Dispelling stray hexes and brushing away uninvited danmaku is merely a casual amusement of mine.
Do stay neatly tucked away so you don't get caught in the crossfire.
Not too long thereafter, the other one came in for revenge and cursed me again...
Along with many other individuals in Gensokyo!
Defeating Berenice gave Veronica even more power to avenge her!
So striking down one only fueled the other with a thirst for vengeance? How predictable.
Let her swell with all the borrowed power she desires; it cannot alter her inevitable end.
I can't risk being cursed a third time, and you are my only hope for ending this madness!
